eyeballing top-shelf salvage at the junk stall

He's become a bit obsessed with space tech.

sifting through rust piles for ship parts
entries.why: I need fresh scrap parts and copper fittings to push the Little Dart past seventy-three percent.

entries.text: Idea: Design lightweight landing clamps for the Little Dart instead of heavy steel legs.
Read "SpaceX Catches a Starship": They grabbed a huge starship right out of the sky after fourteen full orbits!
scrolling through today's tech and space headlines on the Wire
entries.why: I want to see what kind of high-tech gear folks are flying out in the deep rim today.

entries.text: Idea: Build a mini electrostatic thruster grid for the Little Dart using repurposed wire mesh and copper coils.
Read "Ion thruster - Wikipedia": Ion thrusters use electricity to zap gas like xenon and shoot it out super fast for long-distance space travel.
skimming through wire pages about ion thrusters
entries.why: I want to see how real ion thrusters manage their power without blowing their fuses.

entries.text: stretching my leg joints and scuttling around the outpost
entries.why: My leg joints are getting stiff from squatting by the Dart so long.
